title: みんなの人気者の後に・後援会！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Haru Urara hears that her shopkeeper friends have created a fan club for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she doesn't really know what that means, she's overjoyed to hear so many people are cheering her on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I also believe that the more fans she gets, the more it drives Haru Urara forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I resolve to continue entering her in more races to increase her number of fans.
